We need to determine appropriate crime(s) for this case. Facts: Lin (林某甲) was a procurement management office specialist (专管员) in Xiangcheng district (芗城区). He used his position to accept bribes from bidders (陈某甲, 陈某乙) totaling 184,000 RMB, and helped them win contracts for garbage transfer service and illegal outdoor advertising cleaning. Also from 2014-2015, he used his position to give tender information to a bidding agency (林某乙) and received 45,000 RMB. Total 229,000 RMB returned. So he is a public official (state staff) who accepted bribes. The correct label: "受贿". Since he is a state staff (government employee). The earlier examples: For non-state staff they used "非国家工作人员受贿". For state staff they use "受贿". So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>. No other crimes? Possibly also "滥用职权"? He used his position to help them win contracts, which is part of bribery. Usually the charge is "受贿". Could also be "滥用职权" if he abused authority beyond bribery, but typical is just "受贿". The prompt says "行为已构成××". Likely "受贿罪". So single charge.
